subject.title: feat: configurable announce timeout (hardcoded 30s causes A2A reply loss)

question: Should `sessions_send` fire-and-forget A2A use the existing subagent announce timeout, a new A2A-specific timeout/default, or a different durable delivery contract instead of the current 30s budget?
rationale: The source problem is clear, but the fix changes public timeout/default/config semantics and overlaps existing subagent announce and A2A policy surfaces.

options.title: Define A2A-specific contract
options.body: Add or document the canonical A2A timeout/default behavior under the sessions_send/session.agentToAgent owner, then implement tests and docs against it.

options.title: Reuse subagent announce timeout
options.body: Treat `agents.defaults.subagents.announceTimeoutMs` as the shared announce budget and remove the remaining sessions_send-specific caps if maintainers want one owner for both flows.

options.title: Choose durable delivery instead
options.body: Keep timeout knobs narrow and solve fire-and-forget reliability through durable/push result delivery or explicit one-way semantics rather than longer waits.

recommendation.title: Define A2A-specific contract
recommendation.body: Add or document the canonical A2A timeout/default behavior under the sessions_send/session.agentToAgent owner, then implement tests and docs against it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across the sessions_send module split and the product boundary for this public A2A behavior.
